settings.appgachaNotLoggedIn: Not signed in to AppGacha — please sign in first to use the platform channel
settings.appgachaDesc:
With this option, all AI features (gacha generation / wish guide / idea dice / in-egg AI) go through the AppGacha platform channel:
· No API key or endpoint needed
· Models are managed and upgraded by the platform
· Billed by actual token usage, deducted from your credits

Click "Save" below to enable; "Test Connection" verifies login and channel status.
